HAB-1 v8 — honeycomb panels

v7 with no flat skin: the hex cells go right through every panel, 14 mm thick (v7: 1.2 mm skin + 8 mm cells). Joints, keys and clips are v7's. All CAD checks pass; nothing printed yet.

Show

View

Explode0 mm
Section

Colours

  • Blue: lid and floor (same part). Brown, green: walls (all the same part).
  • Yellow: 4 vertical keys. Red: lid keys. Purple: floor keys. Black: the 12 clips (small, on the outer faces; use Explode to see them).

Assembly

  1. Floor down; walls in, fingers interleaved.
  2. Floor keys K4, K3, K2, K1, then the 4 floor clips.
  3. Vertical keys drop into the 4 corners; the 4 wall clips.
  4. Contents in; lid on.
  5. Lid keys K4, K3, K2, K1, then the 4 lid clips.

Open daily: turn the 4 lid clips back and lift them out, pull lid keys K1 to K4, lift the lid.

Numbers (CAD)

  • Cap 210 g ×2, wall 187 g ×4, keys 92 g, clips 1.6 g: 1263 g (CAD, PETG 1.25 g/cm³); v7 was 1163 g.
  • 7 fingers per edge (23 mm), 14 × 14 mm solid edge blocks, 6 × 6 mm keys, 3.85 mm of solid round each key.
  • Panels: open hex cells 18 mm across, 1.6 mm walls, 14 mm deep, no skin; 5 M3 insert bosses each.
  • Bending stiffness about 1.4× v7's panel, in-plane shear stiffness about 1/16 of v7's (computed, docs/34).
